The byte formulas match in all three directions: write count = ceil(a5 / 8) with the final store at dst[count] and carry dst[0]; read count = ceil(a3 / 8) with the final load src[count]; shift 0 length = min(a5, a3), memcpy and the last-byte mask. Both are therefore inside the buffers, so the port's dst_end and src_end guards in CopyBitsIn / CopyBitsOut never fire and the two forms touch the same bytes. Nothing observable differs.
